title: Memory Inspector cells do not re-render: no periodic update, no edit, no keyboard nav
cause: The Memory Inspector memoized cell and row data that did not change identity although the contents changed, so the view showed stale cells.
fix: Update the Memory Inspector extension to 1.3.0 or later, which contains the fix.

title: pyOCD 0.45.0 skips flash algorithm when its RAM address is not a declared memory region
cause: pyOCD 0.45.0 rejects a flash algorithm whose RAMstart lies outside every explicit RAM region of the pack description. The algorithm is dropped and the flash region ends up without a flash instance, although the address is valid RAM on the device.
fix: Use a pyOCD build with the relaxed check (pyOCD PR 2012, shipped in the CMSIS Debugger nightly and later releases). Alternatively the DFP can declare a memory element that covers the algorithm RAM.

title: Mark Active Source Lines switches itself off after every debug session
cause: The CDT GDB Adapter extension wrote cdt.debug.sourceHighlighting=false to the persisted settings when a GDB session ended.
fix: Update the CDT GDB Adapter extension (eclipse-cdt.cdt-gdb-vscode) to 2.9.1 or later. As a stopgap, re-enable the highlighting through the editor context menu, which sets the setting again.
versions: CDT GDB Adapter 2.9.0 affected, fixed in 2.9.1

title: pyocd load: "flash erase sector sequence not available" with flashinfo plus FLM in DFP
symptoms: 0009000 W flash uninit sequence not available [flash_dsq]
0009000 W flash init sequence not available [flash_dsq]
0009003 C flash erase sector sequence not available (address 0x0804a000) [__main__]
cause: The generated cbuild-run file contains both a programming algorithm and a flash-info block for the same region. From pyOCD 0.44 on the flash-info block wins and selects the debug-sequence flash backend, but the DFP defined no flash debug sequences, so programming aborts although a working FLM was present.
fix: Use a pyOCD that falls back to the algorithm when no flash sequences exist (CMSIS Debugger nightly from mid-June 2026, then the next release). Older workaround: delete the flash-info block from the cbuild-run file. A pack should not declare flashinfo without matching sequences.
versions: pyOCD 0.44 and later until the fallback

title: Memory Inspector cannot load back a hex file dumped from addresses above 0x80000000
cause: The Memory Inspector mishandled addresses in the upper half of the 32-bit range when re-importing a dumped hex file; this was an upstream defect of the extension.
fix: Update Memory Inspector to 1.3.0 or later.

title: Live Watch, Component Viewer, Core Peripherals stale after variable or memory write
cause: The views did not react to the DAP events (invalidated, memory) that the adapter sends when memory changes through variable edits or GDB set commands, so only the built-in Watch refreshed.
fix: Use CDT GDB Adapter 2.9.0 together with CMSIS Debugger 1.7.1 or later.
versions: fixed with CDT GDB Adapter 2.9.0 and CMSIS Debugger 1.7.1

title: pyOCD gdbserver TypeError after adding an extra access port to debug-topology
symptoms: 0001483 C Error: 'NoneType' object cannot be interpreted as an integer [__main__]
cause: Adding a further access port (for example an APB-AP for the debug/trace subsystem) to the debug-topology of a cbuild-run file made pyOCD create a GDB server for an entry without a port, which crashed at socket bind. The problem affects ADIv5 and ADIv6 devices.
fix: Use a pyOCD build with the fix (pyOCD PR 1965, available from the nightly after 0.44.0).

title: pyocd load exits 1 after a good flash because the post-load reset drops the connection
cause: The default post-load reset for cbuild-run targets is a hardware reset. With a default or faulty ResetHardware sequence the debug connection is lost right after, the board uninit steps fail, and load returns non-zero although programming worked; the CMSIS Load pre-launch task then shows an error pop-up.
fix: Use a pyOCD with PR 1971 (hardware reset done after uninit; other reset types only report problems as information and exit 0). Or choose the reset type via load-setup post-reset in the solution.

title: pyocd load says "Invalid .cbuild-run.yml file" when given a .cbuild.yml file
symptoms: 0000732 C Invalid .cbuild-run.yml file '<project>/out/App/App.cbuild.yml' [__main__]
cause: The --cbuild-run option was pointed at the cbuild.yml build description instead of the generated *.cbuild-run.yml, and the message did not say what was wrong.
fix: Pass the file ending in .cbuild-run.yml. pyOCD later improved the wording (PR 2003).

title: Run control becomes unresponsive while Component Viewer is open on a multi-core target
cause: The Component Viewer sent requests to GDB at inconvenient moments (during run and step) that could leave the CDT GDB Adapter or GDB hanging; Reset Target sometimes did not recover it.
fix: Update to CMSIS Debugger 1.4.1 or later, which throttles those requests.

title: RTT broken on single-core devices when control block is found by ELF symbol
cause: pyOCD handled the pname of a single-core target wrongly, so the symbol lookup of the RTT control block in the ELF failed.
fix: Update to pyOCD 0.43.1 / CMSIS Debugger 1.4.1 or later; as an alternative give the control block address explicitly.

title: App does not resume from main() with Serial Monitor open (Nu-Link2 probe)
cause: The behaviour came from the Nu-Link2 debug probe firmware, not from the extension.
fix: Update the Nu-Link2 firmware to the latest release from Nuvoton.

title: Component Viewer shows thread names as addresses while the target is running
cause: While the target runs, GDB evaluations had no frame, and the string lookup for names fell back to showing the raw pointer.
fix: Update CMSIS Debugger (fix PR 835 lets such calls run with an undefined frameId, handled by the driver).

title: Component Viewer stays empty when one SCVD file is missing or invalid
cause: One unreadable SCVD (missing file, broken path in the cbuild-run file, syntax error) made the whole view fail instead of only that component.
fix: Update CMSIS Debugger; unreadable SCVD files are now skipped and the others are shown. Check the SCVD paths in the cbuild-run file if a component is missing.

title: "No view is registered with id: cmsis-debugger.componentViewer" after extension update
symptoms: No view is registered with id: cmsis-debugger.componentViewer
cause: After updating from a release without Component Viewer to one with it, and only restarting extensions, VS Code has not registered the new view container.
fix: Reload or restart the VS Code window after the update. Newer versions show a warning with a Reload Window button when they detect this state.

title: Component Viewer shows current instead of maximum stack with OS_STACK_WATERMARK
cause: The numeric conversion of the string returned by GDB for the values was wrong, so current and maximum came out identical on some devices.
fix: Update to a CMSIS Debugger containing PR 854.

title: CMSIS Load fails with SWD "No ACK" on Infineon T2G after a pyOCD update
cause: pyOCD now does a hardware reset after load. The ResetHardware sequence of the DFP breaks the debug connection, so closing the connection reports an error although programming worked.
fix: Set a different post-load reset in the solution, for example under target-set/debugger: load-setup: post-reset: system. pyOCD 0.45 also copes with this better; the DFP sequence should be corrected.

title: pyocd gdb accepts only one client connection; dual-core semihosting output missing
cause: Without --persist pyOCD ends its GDB server after the first client disconnects, so a second attach fails. Semihosting for the second core only worked while both cores were attached, a known pyOCD limitation tracked separately.
fix: Add --persist when starting pyocd gdbserver, or use the generated CMSIS Run task which passes the required options. Attach both cores for semihosting output.

title: Connect mode pre-reset fails with ST-Link probes
symptoms: 0000735 C STLink error (66): Unknown command [__main__]
cause: In pre-reset mode pyOCD ran its post-reset recovery on a device that was not yet connected, which the ST-Link rejects.
fix: Use a pyOCD with PR 2036.

title: pyOCD internal pack support fails when an algorithm path contains ".."
cause: The flash algorithm path from the PDSC was used without normalization, so paths such as Pack/../other/Flash/x.FLM could not be opened.
fix: Use a pyOCD with the normalization fix (PR 1867, merged into develop in December 2025).

title: Live View / Memory Inspector values freeze while the CPU runs (Zephyr idle with WFI)
cause: pyOCD memory cache returns stale values when the target sits in sleep (WFI) in Zephyr idle; reads then do not reach the target. It shows with CMSIS-DAP and ULINKplus but not with J-Link.
fix: Disable the memory cache with -Ocache.enable_memory=false in the pyOCD arguments, or build Zephyr so that it skips WFI while debugging (CONFIG_ARM_ON_ENTER_CPU_IDLE_HOOK with a hook returning false).

title: GDB warnings "pc ... in read in CU, but not in symtab" with Arm Compiler images
symptoms: warning: (Internal error: pc 0x8020a6d8 in read in CU, but not in symtab.)
warning: (Error: pc 0x8020a6d8 in address map, but not in symtab.)
cause: GDB treats all addresses in a CU address table as code addresses, including const objects placed in code sections of AC6 images, then fails a cross-check; reading objects such as osRtxConfig triggers it. The debug info itself looks fine.
fix: The warnings are harmless. CMSIS Debugger 1.3.0 filters this GDB output from the console; GDB CLI use outside VS Code still shows it.

title: pyOCD discovery stops with a critical error when a core AP has no pname in the pack
cause: A core access point discovered during CoreSight discovery (a hidden core) had no matching pname entry in the PDSC, and the mapping step raised instead of ignoring it.
fix: Use a pyOCD with the fix (PR 1865, in develop since December 2025).

title: Internal pyOCD targets fail to program after double buffering was disabled
cause: Disabling double buffering changed the buffer address the algorithm uses, and algorithms of some internal targets relied on the old begin_data location.
fix: Use a pyOCD containing PR 1898 (double buffering kept for internal targets, page_buffers cleaned up, STM32H7 excluded).

title: pyOCD load crashes on flash algorithms without an RW section
symptoms: C Error: 'MemoryRange' object has no attribute 'data' [__main__]
cause: pyOCD assumed every flash algorithm has an RW section and failed on a missing section object.
fix: Use a pyOCD nightly or release after December 2025 that skips absent sections.

title: GDB warning "unable to determine psp alias, assuming psp_s" during Zephyr debug
symptoms: warning: Invalid state, unable to determine psp alias, assuming psp_s.
cause: pyOCD Zephyr thread awareness does not model Secure and Non-secure state, so GDB cannot tell which PSP alias belongs to a paused thread.
fix: Ignore it: only the PSP/MSP alias register values of paused threads may be wrong. The unrelated "pc ... in read in CU" warning has the same harmless nature.

title: Breakpoints cannot be set in assembler files
cause: VS Code only allows breakpoints for languages that a debug extension declares; assembler was not declared.
fix: Update the CDT GDB Adapter extension to 2.5.0 or later, which contributes the assembler language entry.

title: CMSIS-DAP v1 probe initialisation fails because of wrong HID report size handling
cause: pyOCD used incorrect HID report sizes with some CMSIS-DAP v1 probes.
fix: Use a pyOCD with PR 1854 (verified on Windows and macOS; the Linux backend is not hidapi and unchanged).

title: Debug of Alif DevKit-E8 with CMSIS-DAP fails
cause: The reset sequences in the Alif DFP 2.0.x were broken, and the device additionally had to be provisioned with the Alif security tools.
fix: Use Alif DFP 2.1.0 or later, a current CMSIS-Toolbox, and provision the device with the Alif SE tools when switching cores.

title: XRTOS view shows "No RTOS detected" or no threads for RTX5 while the application runs
cause: The RTOS view reads RTOS data only while the target is halted and after osKernelStart.
fix: Pause the target after the kernel started; the threads then show.

title: XRTOS view stuck on "Loading" with Zephyr
cause: RTOS Views 0.0.12 changed Zephyr thread state names and did not work with the Zephyr examples.
fix: Install RTOS Views 0.0.13 or later.

title: Live View only updates when the target is stopped (ST-Link)
cause: The launch configuration had auxiliaryGdb set to true, which does not work for the used server, so live reads were not possible.
fix: Set "auxiliaryGdb": false in the launch configuration for that setup.

title: Debug Console flooded by "Failed to decode cstring" while RTOS Views is open
symptoms: Failed to decode cstring '241 'ñ''. {}
cause: The CDT GDB Adapter failed to decode non-UTF-8 bytes in strings read by the RTOS view and logged each one.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.5.0 or later.

title: Generated J-Link launch configuration on macOS uses JLinkGDBServerCLExe
cause: The debug adapter template used the Windows-style CLExe name, which is not the stable binary on macOS.
fix: Use a CMSIS Solution release with the updated debug adapter registry (template now uses JLinkGDBServerCL), or edit the server name in launch.json.

title: Noisy "Selected thread is running" and "stream was destroyed" errors in Debug Console
symptoms: Selected thread is running
Cannot call write after a stream was destroyed
cause: Views send requests while the target changes state (step/run, disconnect), and the adapter surfaced the resulting internal errors to the user.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.6.0 or later. The related AC6 "not in symtab" warnings come from reading osRtxConfig.

title: HE core on Alif E7 does not start after flashing
cause: Implicit resets between multiple loaded images and a missing clean post-load reset left the core in a bad state.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.40 / CMSIS Debugger 1.2.0 or later (reset catch on all cores, no implicit resets between images, hardware reset after flashing).

title: pyOCD load picks the wrong file type for ELF files with an unusual extension such as .out
cause: Without a cbuild-run file pyOCD decides the format from the file extension; IAR produces .out ELF files.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.39.0 or later, which takes the file type from the cbuild-run file; otherwise pass --format elf.

title: pyocd load with a missing cbuild-run file continues with a generic target and crashes
symptoms: 0000927 C Error: 'CoreSightTarget' object has no attribute 'debugger_clock' [__main__]
0000883 W Generic 'cortex_m' target type is selected by default; is this intentional? You will be able to debug most devices, but not program flash.
cause: The cbuild-run file path was wrong, the access error was only logged, and pyOCD went on with a generic Cortex-M target.
fix: Check the path of the --cbuild-run file. From pyOCD 0.39.0 the missing file ends the command instead.

title: GD-Link (CMSIS-DAP v1 without serial number) not found by pyOCD 0.38 / extension 1.0.0
cause: The hidapi backend regressed for CMSIS-DAP v1 probes that report no USB serial number, although pyocd list shows the probe.
fix: Use a pyOCD with the fix by the CMSIS Debugger team (released after 1.0.0). To test a custom build, change the pyocd path in both launch.json and tasks.json.

title: Load fails with an empty critical error at 10 MHz debug clock on Alif E7 with ULINKplus
cause: The device answers memory requests slowly and SWD/JTAG returns WAIT; pyOCD gave up after too few retries. Lower clocks merely hid it.
fix: Use a pyOCD with more WAIT retries (100, later 150) and better SWD/JTAG error texts; as a workaround reduce the debug clock to 5 MHz.

title: PERIPHERALS view missing when attaching to a GDB server started by Load & Run
cause: The attach launch configuration did not pass the cbuild-run file, so the SVD path was not found.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 1.0.0 or later with CMSIS Solution templates that add cmsis/cbuildRunFile to attach configurations; or add that setting manually.

title: Symbol file paths in cbuild-run are relative to the file, which moved to the out folder
cause: pyOCD resolved relative paths against the working directory; with CMSIS-Toolbox 2.11 the cbuild-run file sits in out.
fix: Use pyOCD with PR 1788 (paths resolved relative to the cbuild-run file location).

title: Erase device fails on STM32 dual-core boards
cause: The memory region lookup ignored the pname attribute, so it picked the wrong core region.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.40.0 or later.

title: CMSIS-DAP v1 (HID) probes fail on macOS with "already open"
symptoms: 0100505 C Error: already open [__main__]
cause: The libusb path timed out on HID probes on macOS, and the follow-up open raised.
fix: Use a pyOCD with the hidapi change (PR 1792), shipped from CMSIS Debugger 1.0.0.

title: Attach to a core without program image is refused
cause: The CDT GDB Adapter required a program for attach requests.
fix: Use a CDT GDB Adapter release containing the fix (PR 262), so attach works without "program".

title: Unclear errors "No ACK received" and empty "Error:" when probe or target is missing
symptoms: 0001410 C No ACK received [__main__]
0019032 C Error:  [__main__]
cause: pyOCD printed bare SWD/JTAG status for typical wiring or clock problems.
fix: Use a pyOCD with PR 1804: messages read like "SWD/JTAG communication failure (No ACK received); check USB cable, reduce debugger clock". Check cable, power, and lower the debug clock.

title: Custom Reset button fails with "The custom reset command failed" while the target runs
symptoms: The custom reset command failed
cause: GDB refuses remote commands while the CPU is running, and the adapter issued the reset without halting first.
fix: Pause the target before pressing Custom Reset. The adapter was changed (PR 464) to halt first; it does not auto-resume afterwards.

title: pyocd load prints a TypeError in load-svd and "flash init timed out"
symptoms: TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not NoneType
0005770 C flash init timed out [__main__]
cause: The installed DFP version lacked the SVD file, so the SVD loader got None as path.
fix: Update the DFP to a version that ships the SVD; the cbuild-run file lists it under system-descriptions.

title: Peripheral view does not update during single stepping
cause: The debug-tracker-vscode extension (dependency of RTOS Views) clashed with the Peripheral Inspector, which could not tell session IDs apart.
fix: Update Peripheral Inspector to 1.8.1 or later; disabling mcu-debug.debug-tracker-vscode also helps.

title: Target reset button disappears when a second core is attached
cause: The launch configuration of the second core had no customResetCommands.
fix: Use a CMSIS Solution release with the updated debug adapter templates, or add customResetCommands to the attach configuration.

title: Misleading error for attach request when no GDB server runs
cause: The adapter passed through GDB messages, which differ by OS (a drive-joining text on Windows, a timeout text on macOS).
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter (PR 413 unifies the message). Start the GDB server first.

title: pyocd erase says "unrecognized arguments: --cbuild-run"
symptoms: pyocd: error: unrecognized arguments: --cbuild-run
cause: A pyOCD without cbuild-run support was used, not the one shipped with the CMSIS Debugger extension.
fix: Use the pyOCD of the CMSIS Debugger extension (launch server "pyocd") and CMSIS Solution tasks that match it.

title: Leftover pyOCD process blocks later sessions with "Access denied"
cause: After a failed launch (for example missing GDB) the adapter left the pyOCD server running.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.1.0 or later; as a workaround end the pyocd process.

title: pyOCD does not use the default CMSIS_PACK_ROOT
cause: pyOCD only read the environment variable and ignored the documented platform default.
fix: Use a newer pyOCD that applies the default, or set CMSIS_PACK_ROOT.

title: monitor reset leaves GUI out of sync; use monitor reset halt
cause: pyOCD monitor commands change the CPU state without GDB async records, so the GUI does not learn about running or stopped.
fix: Use "monitor reset halt" and the adapter reset button (resetDeviceCommands/customResetCommands such as monitor reset halt hardware). Step once to resync.

title: Typing GDB commands in the Debug Console gives var-create errors
symptoms: -var-create: unable to create variable object
cause: The Debug Console treats input as expressions; the CDT GDB Adapter takes GDB CLI commands only with a ">" prefix.
fix: Start the command with ">" for example "> help".

title: Attach again to the same core fails after detaching
cause: pyOCD gdbserver exits after the client disconnects unless --persist is given.
fix: Add --persist to the pyOCD gdbserver arguments (now in the templates).

title: Memory reads and views fail while the CPU runs (SIGINT interrupts)
cause: GDB suppresses remote commands while the target runs; non-stop mode did not work well with RTOS threads.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.40+ with CDT GDB Adapter 2.4.0+ which opens an auxiliary GDB connection to the same port (auxiliaryGdb); set auxiliaryGdb false where the server does not allow it.

title: Cannot read memory at peripheral register addresses with pyOCD
symptoms: Unable to read memory
cause: GDB had no memory map entry for peripheral ranges, so reads failed.
fix: Use pyOCD patch release 0.1.1 or later (alternative: set mem inaccessible-by-default off).

title: Debug sequence fails with invalid __apid on Access Port v2 devices
symptoms: E Error while running debug sequence 'ResetSystem' (core M55_HP): __apid has invalid value (2097152)
cause: The AP address classes lacked apid handling for APv2.
fix: Use a pyOCD from the CMSIS Debugger 0.2/1.0 era or later.

title: CoreSight discovery fails on MEM-APs with SPROT field
symptoms: E Transfer error while reading AHB-AP#1 ROM table: Memory transfer fault @ 0xe00fefd0-0xe00fefff [ap]
cause: The HNONSEC bit in CSW was handled wrongly for MEM-APs that implement SPROT.
fix: Use a pyOCD with the SPROT CSW handling (CMSIS Debugger 0.2 and later).

title: Debugger hangs when more breakpoints are set than hardware allows
cause: GDB accepts all and fails at continue with "Command aborted" after sending ^running; the adapter had already dropped the command.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter (PR 415); remove surplus breakpoints. Workaround: set breakpoint always-inserted on in initCommands.

title: Flash programming fails on LPC55S69 when the device is erased
cause: Reading erased flash for the compare step produced bus errors.
fix: Use a pyOCD that skips reading erased sectors when the algorithm has Verify (CMSIS Debugger 0.2+).

title: CoreSight root components on APv2 are read from wrong addresses
cause: ap_address was passed to the memory interface for root components.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 0.2+ pyOCD.

title: Flash programming fails when erased flash reads as 0x00
cause: If PC reads 0 after reset the Thumb bit in xPSR is clear, so running the algorithm faults.
fix: Use a pyOCD that sets the Thumb bit in xPSR before algorithm calls.

title: Unreliable flash programming on STM32H7 (hard fault after load)
cause: Double-buffered downloads stall on buses with strict timing.
fix: Use a pyOCD with double buffering off by default (later restored only for internal targets).

title: Warning "invalid control node" and then connect crash on multi-core Infineon T2G
symptoms: 0001777 W invalid 'control' node in debug sequence 'PrintDeviceInfo' [cmsis_pack]
0000954 C Error: <APv1Address@0x1a968104350 #1 dp=0> [__main__]
cause: Old native pack sequence handling skipped a control node without if/while; and multi-core devices need a debug-topology in the cbuild-run file.
fix: Use pyOCD with cbuild-run debug sequences (0.0.3 pre-release and later) and a CMSIS-Toolbox 2.9+ cbuild-run file with debug-topology (debugports, accessports, processors).

title: GDB server exits with "RW section does not follow RO section"
symptoms: 0001679 C RW section does not follow RO section [__main__]
cause: pyOCD checked the flash algorithm layout too strictly and ignored section alignment.
fix: Use a pyOCD with PR 1795 (CMSIS Debugger 1.0.0 and later).

title: Target stays halted after disconnect with pyOCD
cause: The adapter killed the GDB server immediately, before pyOCD could turn off debug and resume the CPU.
fix: Use CDT GDB Adapter with a server kill delay (PRs 405/175); keep automaticallyKillServer.

title: pyOCD without libusb on macOS cannot connect to CMSIS-DAPv2 probes
symptoms: 0001425 W STLink, CMSIS-DAPv2 and PicoProbe probes are not supported because no libusb library was found. [common]
cause: The bundled pyOCD did not contain libusb.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 0.2+ which bundles libusb.

title: Auto-detection fails on NXP K32L3A6 multi-core device
symptoms: 0001184 C Error: <APv1Address@0x1e77c825b50 #2 dp=0> [__main__]
cause: Debug-topology missing from cbuild-run; DFP 19.0.0 listed wrong AP index for the M0+.
fix: Add debug-topology with cm4 apid 0 index 0 and cm0plus apid 1 index 2 to the cbuild-run file, or use a corrected DFP and newer toolbox.

title: LPC55S69 flash download via GDB fails with memory transfer fault
symptoms: 0007677 E Error while running debug sequence 'ResetSystem' (core cm33_core0): Memory transfer fault [pack_target]
cause: Same root cause as the monitor reset halt failure: ResetSystem handling and missing multi-core topology.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 0.2+ pyOCD and ensure the cbuild-run debug-topology lists both APs.

title: monitor reset halt fails on LPC55S69 with CMSIS-Pack debug support
symptoms: 0007776 E Error while running debug sequence 'ResetSystem' (core cm33_core0): Memory transfer fault [pack_target]
cause: Handling of __errorcontrol and __ap in sequences was wrong; two APs must be declared.
fix: Use pyOCD with the fix and give two accessports (apid 0 index 0, apid 1 index 1) with cm33_core0/cm33_core1.

title: "Zephyr kernel detected" warning when debugging bare metal
symptoms: 0002477 W Zephyr kernel detected. Build your Zephyr application with `CONFIG_DEBUG_THREAD_INFO=y` to enable thread awareness. [zephyr]
cause: A newer pyOCD main change raised the warning without checking an RTOS.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 0.2+ pyOCD.

title: GDB server fails to start but the adapter keeps waiting for a timeout
symptoms: gdbserver has exited with code 1
cause: The adapter did not notice early exit of the GDB server.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.1.0 or later; check the server error in the console.

title: Hover shows "-var-create: unable to create variable object" for non-variables
symptoms: -var-create: unable to create variable object
cause: Hovering text that is no variable made the adapter report the GDB error.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.0.4 or later.

title: Connect fails with cbuild-run when CMSIS_PACK_ROOT is not set
cause: The pack-based support needed CMSIS_PACK_ROOT and the default was not applied.
fix: Set CMSIS_PACK_ROOT or use a version that applies defaults (see the toolbox default locations).

title: GDB commands in Debug Console fail while CPU runs: no frameId
symptoms: Evaluation of expression without frameId is not supported.
cause: The adapter required a frame for evaluation, which does not exist while running.
fix: Use CDT GDB Adapter 2.4+ with an auxiliary GDB connection (auxiliaryGdb) for running targets.

title: "GDB unhandled notify: breakpoint-created" for breakpoints set from the console
symptoms: GDB unhandled notify: breakpoint-created
cause: The adapter did not handle GDB breakpoint notifications, so CLI breakpoints did not show in the GUI.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter beyond 2.0.x as announced in that thread.
